notes: Item 19 is fully present with extensive data across 14 tables. Table 1 (affiliate P&L) figures are in thousands as stated in document. Table 2 provides individual affiliate outlet data. Tables 3A-3C provide consolidated P&L averages per franchisee/territory for all, multi-unit, and single-unit franchisees respectively. Tables 4-7 provide all-owner performance breakdowns. Tables 8-10 cover multi-unit owners. Tables 11-13 cover single-unit owners. Table 14 provides individual owner-level data. Outlet counts for Tables 3A-3C are not explicitly stated in the text visible; 55 total owners inferred from Table 14 list (55 rows). Tables 3A-3C show per-unit/territory averages while Tables 4-13 are per-owner. The affiliate-owned outlets operate in large multi-territory areas so their revenue figures are not directly comparable to a standard single-territory franchise unit. Confidence is 0.90 due to some image-only tables (3A, 3B, 3C were partially in images) though all figures were successfully extracted from the text portions.
